title: Test date ranges
skill: Show the exact test shape and the boundaries

good: Create tests/test_date_range.py for expand() in date_range.py. Use unittest and start the file like tests/test_smoke.py (sys.path insert). Table format: CASES = [("2026-03-01..2026-03-03", ["2026-03-01", "2026-03-02", "2026-03-03"]), ("2026-03-01", ["2026-03-01"]), (" 2026-03-01 .. 2026-03-02 ", ["2026-03-01", "2026-03-02"]), ("2026-01-31..2026-02-01", ["2026-01-31", "2026-02-01"]), ("2028-02-28..2028-03-01", ["2028-02-28", "2028-02-29", "2028-03-01"]), ("2026-01-01..2026-01-31", [f"2026-01-{d:02d}" for d in range(1, 32)])] and ERRORS = ["2026-03-02..2026-03-01", "", "2026-02-30", "2026-3-1", "2026-01-01..2026-02-01"]. One test loops over CASES with self.subTest and assertEqual; one loops over ERRORS with self.subTest and assertRaises(ValueError). Do not change date_range.py or tests/test_smoke.py. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: Write tests for the date range parser.
